title: Priority Task Scheduler with Rate Limiting and Dependencies
prompt: Fix `starter/scheduler.py` so that all documented invariants hold. The scheduler must respect dependency ordering, priority with FIFO tie-break, token-bucket rate limiting with burst cap, and the state-machine rules (RUNNING is non-cancellable, FAILED propagates). It must also meet the performance requirement (heap-based ready queue, no expensive sorts). See the code for the full contract — the prompt is intentionally brief.
